title: [Back Order] 4 Months Restor Hair Regrowth Minoxidil 5% Extra Strength (Men & Woman) $39.99 Delivered @ PharmacySavings
body:
Deal: [Back Order] 4 Months Restor Hair Regrowth Minoxidil 5% Extra Strength (Men & Woman) $39.99 Delivered @ PharmacySavings

[eunkookie] Hi Jason,
I bought your minoxidil solution last time and it's working great for me so far. Noticed that it is classified as flammable liquid though, hence wont be able to bring it overseas. Is this also the same for this spray model (classified as flammable liquid 3)?

Also, how do you use the treatment? I've never used it before. I just bought ketoconazole (Nizoral) for hair growth.
[tobuyRnot2buy] How does ketoconazole help for hair growth? I am curious to know. Thanks
[Zeee] I read online, it reduces the inflammation and blocking dht
[Zeee] @iDroid: Honestly I just started 2 weeks ago. It wont work if you are bald.

[paloverde88] just pour into another bottle and label it herbal flu medication to be taken orally
[shinpathy] lol taken plenty of sprays like this and not once has it been an issue
[gtech] Does this stuff makes you lose your existing hair before regrowing? Or does it just supplement exiting hair growth?
[OzPeter] Add rosemary oil In the bottle and mix, to boost the hair growth!
[vlahka] I used this stuff for about a month. Sadly I had one of the side affects which made my balls hurt for weeks while using it. I'd rather go bald.
[jesho] This has worked extremely well for me paired with Finasteride.
[reactor-au] Ask your GP for an off label prescription for hair loss
[AustriaBargain] Your hair was thinning and you used this and it stopped thinning?
[jesho] Yes, it stopped losing hair and helped regrow hair. You need to get a prescription for Finasteride.
[ozy] Hormone levels need a good doctor to follow you on that route.
[reactor-au] I had a bit of issue on 1mg/day but I've been okay on 0.5mg/day
[reactor-au] @Zeee: Yes it can for some people, some reports of some being irreversible
[dobol] Is this for men or women? or it doesn't matter?
[R3XNebular] OP's title should be men and women plural.. haha
[ozy] Both
Doesn’t matter.
Women also bald and I know women that use this, I’m literally buying more from this deal for one of them.
Cheers OP
[crazy94boy] Be careful if you have a cat.. Minoxidil is highly toxic to them
[Skinnerr] https://i.ytimg.com/vi/jh17tdxRkeU/hqdefault.jpg
[SirFaffer] Just realised how fortunate I am to still have a full head of hair at 45.
[hasher22] You can use this as a prevention measure as well, once you start noticing thinning or fall out alot… I would go on it straight away.
[EyyBanane] Don’t start mate, once you start you cannot stop or you will lose everything. Delay it as much as possible if at all you must.
[Dollar Dreamer] Is this a lifetime subscription to hair or a monthly subscription? As in, I will have to keep buying it every 4 months?
[despavr] Yes you need to continue using minoxidil to maintain the hair grown by it.
[hasher22] Just wondering why the "bonus" items are slightly more expensive than just buying the Minoxidil?
Shouldn't you call it a bundle instead of "bonus"?
[jason101] Yes - fair call, they were once a bonus item (see my previous expired deals) but as buy prices crept up so did the price of the main item (and the main item with the bonus), so its certainly out of kilter now with prices all over the place. I'll have a look when I get a chance, thanks for pointing out - currently packing many, many orders.

If so, no thanks.

[seamonkey] It's now back order….which isn't helpful…..need it for head hair not back hair.
